test_overview: Evaluated the Tier 3 Approximate matching test plan against the running Furniture Delivery Calculator (http://localhost:8000). All three steps executed successfully through the UI as a human QA would: (1) Created a B2C quote from Warehouse Central to 'Mt Albert' with a 3-Seater Sofa and zeroed services, clicked Calculate, and verified the Tier 3 Approximate match selected the highest-rate card (Mount Alberton, $110.00) on the LCS tie-break, with correct pricing ($132.00 total, $110.00 rate, 1.20 volume charged, $132.00 base delivery). (2) Opened the candidates modal listing all 3 candidates with city/rate/LCS (9), ordered by descending ratePerM3 (Mount Alberton $110 -> Mount Albert North $105 -> Mount Albert $100), closed it, and confirmed the selection/pricing were unchanged. (3) Saved the quote (observed 'Quote saved successfully!'), verified it in the Quotes list (Approximate, $132.00), and in the Quote detail (preserved 'Matched to: Mount Alberton', rate $110.00, volume 1.20, base delivery $132.00). Every fatal and non-fatal verification passed. Total score 24/24.
